title: 1st Annual Meeting of Society for Neuropeptides and Neuroendocrinology
metaInfo: Dr. Amul Sakharkar (Dept. of Biotechnology, SPPU, India amul.sakharkar@unipune.ac.in) & Dr. Aurnab Ghoshe (IISER, Pune, India, aurnab@iiser.ac.in)
description: The flagship annual gathering bringing together clinical practitioners and basic laboratory scientists across India to evaluate modern neuropeptide dynamics.
modalMessage: Registration for the flagship Annual Conference will open officially alongside abstract acceptance feedback. Ensure your SNPN membership is active to lock down discounted delegate entry paths.

title: K.S. Krishnan Memorial Lecture in Neuroscience
description: Featuring Prof. Marianne Bronner from Caltech exploring 'Neural Crest Contributions to Head, Heart and Gut', mapping developmental mechanics in vertebrate lineages.
modalMessage: Organized by the Neuroscience Interest Group at IISER Pune. The lecture is open to all students, scholars, and faculty members without prior registration.

title: XLIV Annual Meeting of Indian Academy of Neurosciences
description: Centering on 'Advances in Neuroscience in Health and Disease', bringing researchers and clinicians together to shape investigative frameworks.
modalMessage: Hosted at the BRIC-National Brain Research Centre (NBRC), Manesar. Includes keynotes, poster panels, and technical abstract sessions for registered delegates.

title: 7th Bangalore Cognition Workshop & Public Lecture
description: Hosted by the Centre for Neuroscience (CNS) at IISc, featuring Dr. Nicholas Betley from UPenn exploring deep structural brain-behavior circuit mapping.
modalMessage: Session summaries and cognitive systems references can be verified directly via the official Centre for Neuroscience (CNS) documentation channels.
